g.text: GOUT: fluids UP + weight down + alcohol (esp. beer) down + red-meat/seafood moderate +
cherries/veg welcome; drugs (allopurinol/colchicine) per doctor — diet HELPS, meds CONTROL.
ALLERGY (immune, fast, can kill — hives/swelling/wheeze/collapse): avoid trigger STRICTLY,
label-read, adrenaline where prescribed + action plan; INTOLERANCE (slow, gut-led — lactose):
KIDNEY DETAIL: protein per stage/dialysis (dietician/doctor set — too little wastes
muscle!); potassium leach (peel + soak + boil + discard water — yam/plantain/cocoyam!);
salt <1 tsp + no added at table; fluids measured (prior-day urine + 500 mL typical — follow
order!); phosphate binders WITH meals; daily weights + BP + oedema watched.
DYSPHAGIA (GER link!): NBM till screened → textures + upright + referrals; HIATUS/REFLUX:
small + upright + late-meals out + weight down; POST-OP gut: advance as ordered + protein
for healing; PANCREATITIS: NBM → low-fat advance per doctor.
COUNSELLING: restrictions explained by REASON ("potassium stops hearts when kidneys fail —
leaching protects you") + shown (demo leaching!) + written lists (eat/avoid) + cook trained +
review + labs trended (K+, creatinine, LFTs, glucose). Forbidden-only counsel fails — always
pair "stop X" with "eat Y instead". Document diet + demos + labs + review.
RED FLAGS: K+ symptoms (weakness/palpitations) · fluid overload (breathless/oedema/gain) ·
GI bleed (vomit blood/black stool) · anaphylaxis (adrenaline + emergency) · ascites fever/
confusion — emergency pathways, diet never delays hospital.
